v4.9.072 - #337 reverted (#343)

#337 put the story-flow breaks inside the arrangement so the whole thing
travelled as one item. It also changed the SHAPE of a stored settings value that
had been a plain list since #294 - and the app then decided its settings had
changed on every pass. It pushed; that bumped the project's time on the server;
the heartbeat saw something newer and pulled; the pull redrew the screen; and it
pushed again. The iPad churned every few seconds and nothing the user opened
stayed open.

Roman had already said the old behaviour was the wanted one: a break sits where
you put it, by position, and the later change wins. So it goes back to that, and
the breaks are their own items again. A value written in the hour #337 was live
is still read, so nothing from that window is stranded.

#338, #340, #341 and #342 stay.
